[2026.07]
		 1 paper accepted to ACMMM 2026: MorphDreamer: Progressive Particle Splitting for Weighted Entropy Regularized Variational Text-to-3D Generation.
		 Congrats Yingmei!

[2026.05]
		 1 paper accepted to IEEE TPAMI 2026: MPQ-DMv2: Flexible Residual Mixed Precision Quantization for Low-Bit Diffusion Models with Temporal Distillation.
		 Congrats Weilun!

[2026.05]
		 1 paper accepted to KDD 2026: PrePrompt: Predictive Prompting for Class Incremental Learning.

[2026.05]
		 2 papers accepted to ICML 2026: 
		 WorldCache: Accelerating World Models for Free via Heterogeneous Token Caching,
		 Fast-SAM3D: 3Dfy Anything in Images but Faster.
		 Congrats Weilun, Mingqiang, and Guoxin!

[2026.03]
		 1 paper accepted to ICME 2026: DFM: Difference Feature Modeling with Text-Guided Gated Contrastive Loss for Remote Sensing Image Change Captioning. Congrats Yelin!

[2026.02]
		4 papers accepted to CVPR 2026: 
		(1) Representation-Steered Incremental Adapter-Tuning for Class-Incremental Learning with Pre-Trained Models,
		(2) EfficientVPR: Toward Efficient Visual Place Recognition via Scene-Aware Prompt Tuning and Adaptive Feature Enhancement,
		(3) Parameterized Prompt for Incremental Object Detection,
		(4) Distilling Out-of-Distribution Knowledge from Large Language Models for CLIP Generalization [findings workshop].
		Congrats Jiarui, Wenjing, Zijia, and Qiji!

[2026.01]
		3 papers accepted to ICLR 2026: 
		(1) QuantSparse: Comprehensively Compressing Video Diffusion Transformer with Model Quantization and Attention Sparsification,
		(2) Quantized Visual Geometry Grounded Transformer,
		(3) Point-UQ: An Uncertainty-Quantification Paradigm for Point Cloud Few-Shot Class Incremental Learning.
		Congrats Weilun and Xiangqi!

[2025.12]
		获中国科学院计算技术研究所2025年度“优秀研究人员”。

Congrats Chuanguang (& Xinqiang), Weilun, and Han!

		Congrats Zijia and Haonan!
